audience: businesses in Lithuania that issue invoices and record expenses in F-sąskaita

useCases.title: Review recent invoices and their totals
useCases.text: List the finalized invoices, newest first. Open one invoice to see its seller, buyer, lines, totals and share link.

useCases.title: Download an invoice PDF for a client
useCases.text: List the invoices, then download the PDF of the one you need. Files over 3 MB are refused.

useCases.title: Create a new invoice with its lines
useCases.text: Read the business profile and the currency codes first. Then create and finalize the invoice. After a network error, list invoices before you retry.

useCases.title: Correct an invoice without renumbering it
useCases.text: Read the invoice, then resend all of its fields with the same invoice number. The PDF is regenerated.

useCases.title: Record an expense with its receipt
useCases.text: Review the expenses and their totals. Then record a new expense with the receipt or supplier invoice file.
